usage: music-tagger art [-h] [--release-id RELEASE_ID]
                        [--cover-file COVER_FILE] [--full] [--force] [--embed]
                        [--preview] [--log LOG | --no-log]
                        path

Fetch cover art from the Cover Art Archive, or use a local image.

positional arguments:
  path                  Album directory to save cover art into.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --release-id RELEASE_ID
                        MusicBrainz release UUID.
  --cover-file COVER_FILE
                        Use a local image instead of fetching.
  --full                Fetch full-size image instead of 500px.
  --force               Replace the album's existing cover.* file.
  --embed               Embed cover art into all audio files. A PNG, or a JPEG
                        too large for a FLAC picture block, is embedded as a
                        converted JPEG; the folder keeps the original.
  --preview             Download the release's full-size front cover to a temp
                        file for review. Writes nothing to the album.
  --log LOG             Append changes to this log file (default:
                        $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                        tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log              Do not write the change log.
